name: dream-home-visualizer
description: Roomify Studio for Windows and Android with verified floor-plan geometry, 19 design styles, dual photoreal top-down and eye-level Blender renders, mobile upload and native sharing
author: Upenyu Hlangabeza

scripts.dev:main: tsup src/main/main.ts src/main/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --out-dir dist-electron --watch --sourcemap
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/main.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.test:portal-stability: cd backend && python -m tests.smoke_shared_portals && python -m tests.smoke_exterior_space
scripts.build:main: tsup src/main/main.ts src/main/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --out-dir dist-electron --sourcemap && node scripts/verify-electron-bundle.mjs
scripts.build: npm run test:ui-stability && npm run test:mobile && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.dist:windows: npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run build:renderer && npm run android:prepare
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
